name: zclass_display_set_position
description: zClass_Display::gwDisplaySetPosition validates a display node and stores display origin coordinates.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass display/source-cluster pass because the adjacent display helpers share the same validation shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44ff10 validates null node, null class-data, and wrong-class old error paths, then stores x at display-data offset 0 and y at offset 4 before returning 0.
The native smoke verifies successful x/y storage plus null-node, null-data, and wrong-class return codes through the shared display helper validation path.
